events.content:
Migration complete and verified (build passes + runtime check confirms both routes render with correct titles).

**What changed:**
- `app/layout.tsx` — root layout replacing `_app.tsx` + `_document.tsx`; renders `<html lang="en">`/`<body>` and holds shared metadata (title default, description, favicon `icon`) plus the global `viewport` export.
- `app/page.tsx` — home page; `<Head>` dropped, inherits root metadata, `<a>` → `<Link>` from `next/link`.
- `app/about/page.tsx` — about page; per-page `metadata` export (title "About Us", description) overrides defaults, `<a>` → `<Link>`.
- Removed the entire `pages/` directory (including `_app.tsx`, `_document.tsx`).

**Verification:** `next build` compiled with TypeScript passing, routes `/`, `/about`, `/_not-found` all prerendered as static. Runtime curl confirmed `/` → "Home Page"/"Home" and `/about` → "About Us"/"About", with `<html lang="en">` intact.
